cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Stay for the Result
cards.instruction: Keep them present until the contest, bargain, or consequence reaches an undeniable outcome.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've folded my bill like yours. Don't go yet; we need to agree exactly what your starter cost.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Those are napkins. The bill's the long slip beside your plate.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The itemized one, of course. Stay while I check your starter on that one.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I paid the waiter already. There's a card receipt underneath.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then read me the total you paid. We're finishing this with a number, not 'I sorted it.'

reason: Replace the disconnected confidence prefaces with a specific copied act whose correction changes A's pursuit. Keep the exact Drive motive in the same exchange and give B a practical stake.
